business.name: Super Fusion Cuisine II
business.summary: Long-standing Japanese casual dining institution and sushi bar famous for generous sashimi cuts, signature toro specialty maki, and fresh fusion rolls.
business.smsPrompt: Hi, I would like to place an order for pickup/delivery at Super Fusion Cuisine II.

parkingAndTransit.parkingNote: Street metered parking available along Mt. Auburn Street and in nearby Watertown Square municipal parking lots.
parkingAndTransit.transitNote: Conveniently located 2 minutes on foot from Watertown Square station, connecting MBTA bus lines 57, 70, and 71.

offerings.title: Watertown Maki
offerings.description: Spicy tuna, yellowtail, and avocado, topped with a layer of torched salmon and eel sauce.

offerings.title: Double Toro Maki
offerings.description: Seared toro, avocado, and cucumber topped with torched toro, spicy mayo, eel sauce, and tempura crumbs.

offerings.title: 54 Maki
offerings.description: Shrimp, avocado, and mango topped with spicy lobster, imitation crab, and tobiko.

offerings.title: Baked Salmon Maki
offerings.description: Imitation crab stick, tempura crumbs, and spicy mayo topped with salmon, spicy powder, and baked eel sauce.

offerings.title: Fusion Maki Combo (18 pcs)
offerings.description: Tuna roll, California roll, and shrimp tempura roll; served with miso soup.

offerings.title: Chirashi Sushi
offerings.description: Chef's selection of fresh assorted sashimi arranged over seasoned sushi rice, accompanied by miso soup.

reviews.author: Linda K.
reviews.text: The best place to pick up sushi. They're quick, efficient, and very friendly. Consistently sublime service.

reviews.author: Cat M.
reviews.text: The fish is super fresh and the entrées and combination platters are excellent! Staff is always friendly and prompt.

reviews.author: Lauryn T.
reviews.text: My go-to sushi restaurant! The food is always perfect and prepared quickly.
